scripts.bootstrap:wasm: cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --version 0.2.127 --root .tools/wasm-bindgen && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.package:agent-host: pnpm plugin:stage && pnpm plugin:validate && node scripts/package-agent-host.mjs
scripts.plugin:install:local: pnpm plugin:stage && pnpm plugin:validate && node scripts/installed-plugin-check.mjs --install --runtime-smoke
scripts.test:figma: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:wasm:figma && pnpm --filter @worldbend/figma test
scripts.carrier:compile-check: cargo check --locked -p worldbend-wasm --no-default-features && cargo check --locked -p worldbend-cli --bin worldbend --no-default-features --features comfy
scripts.test:ui: pnpm build:web && pnpm build:wasm:figma && pnpm --filter @worldbend/web test && pnpm --filter @worldbend/figma test
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm test:ui
scripts.check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && pnpm carrier:compile-check && pnpm contract:check && pnpm test:scripts && pnpm test:ui && pnpm performance:smoke && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:figma:entries && pnpm carrier:figma-runtime-check && pnpm package:figma-designer:from-build && pnpm plugin:stage && pnpm plugin:validate && pnpm runtime:smoke && pnpm capability:check && node scripts/check-built-artifacts.mjs
